typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Market as string,
		{Subscriber No} as string,
		{Medicaid No} as string,
		{First Name} as string,
		{Last Name} as string,
		Address as string,
		Phone as string,
		{Birth Date} as string,
		{Age Band} as string,
		{Age In Years} as string,
		{Age In Months} as string,
		Service as string,
		{Due From Date} as string,
		{Due To Date} as string,
		{Minimum Count} as string,
		{Schedule Desc} as string,
		{Previous Service Dates Given} as string,
		AffNum as string,
		{PCP Full Name} as string,
		{Provider Last Seen} as string,
		{Provider Last Seen Address} as string,
		{Provider Last Seen Phone} as string,
		{Last Service Date} as string,
		HOHFamilyLink as string,
		ProvTaxID as string,
		GroupName as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT  CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), Market) AS Market ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(15), Member) AS \'Subscriber No\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), MedicaidNo) AS \'Medicaid No\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), FirstName) AS \'First Name\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), LastName) AS \'Last Name\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), [Address]) AS Address ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), Phone) AS Phone ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), BirthDate) AS \'Birth Date\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), AgeBand) AS \'Age Band\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), AgeInYears) AS \'Age In Years\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), AgeInMonths) AS \'Age In Months\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), [Service]) AS Service ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), DueFromDate) AS \'Due From Date\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), DueToDate) AS \'Due To Date\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), MinimumCount) AS \'Minimum Count\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(150), ScheduleDesc) AS \'Schedule Desc\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), PreviousSvcDates) AS \'Previous Service Dates Given\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), AffNum) AS AffNum ,CASE WHEN ProviderFullName = \'\' THEN \'No Provider Name\' ELSE ProviderFullName END AS \'PCP Full Name\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), Provider_TaxID) AS \'ProvTaxID\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), Group_Name) AS \'GroupName\' ,(select top 1 MC.ProviderName from EPSDT.dbo.EPSDTProactiveMemberClaims MC where MC.ClaimID = B.ClaimID) AS \'Provider Last Seen\'  ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),(select top 1 MC.ProviderAddress from EPSDT.dbo.EPSDTProactiveMemberClaims MC where MC.ClaimID = B.ClaimID)) AS \'Provider Last Seen Address\' ,(select top 1 MC.ProviderPhone from EPSDT.dbo.EPSDTProactiveMemberClaims MC where MC.ClaimID = B.ClaimID) AS \'Provider Last Seen Phone\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), LastServiceDate) AS \'Last Service Date\' ,CONVERT (VARCHAR(12), HOHFamilyLink) AS \'HOHFamilyLink\' FROM EPSDT.dbo.EPSDTProactiveMemberList B(nolock) WHERE ProgNum = ? AND AgeBand = ? ORDER BY 1, 2, 12, 13, 14',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of HOHFamilyLink} = toString(HOHFamilyLink),
		{Copy of AffNum} = toString(AffNum),
		{Copy of Phone} = toString(Phone),
		{Copy of Service} = toString(Service),
		{Copy of GroupName} = toString(GroupName),
		{Copy of Market} = toString(Market),
		{Copy of ProvTaxID} = toString(ProvTaxID),
		{Copy of Address} = toString(Address)) ~> DataConversion
ExcelDestination derive({} = {}) ~> ExcelDestinationErrorReformat
ExcelDestinationErrorReformat sink(input(
		Provider_Last_Seen as string,
		ErrorColumn as integer,
		Birth_Date as string,
		Address as string,
		Provider_Last_Seen_Address as string,
		Age_In_Years as string,
		Age_In_Months as string,
		First_Name as string,
		Medicaid_No as string,
		Phone as string,
		Subscriber_No as string,
		Due_From_Date as string,
		Minimum_Count as string,
		Previous_Service_Dates_Given as string,
		Provider_Last_Seen_Phone as string,
		Service as string,
		PCP_Full_Name as string,
		Market as string,
		Last_Service_Date as string,
		AffNum as string,
		Schedule_Desc as string,
		Age_Band as string,
		Last_Name as string,
		Due_To_Date as string,
		ErrorCode as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Provider_Last_Seen = {Provider Last Seen},
		ErrorColumn,
		Birth_Date = {Birth Date},
		Address,
		Provider_Last_Seen_Address = {Provider Last Seen Address},
		Age_In_Years = {Age In Years},
		Age_In_Months = {Age In Months},
		First_Name = {First Name},
		Medicaid_No = {Medicaid No},
		Phone,
		Subscriber_No = {Subscriber No},
		Due_From_Date = {Due From Date},
		Minimum_Count = {Minimum Count},
		Previous_Service_Dates_Given = {Previous Service Dates Given},
		Provider_Last_Seen_Phone = {Provider Last Seen Phone},
		Service,
		PCP_Full_Name = {PCP Full Name},
		Market,
		Last_Service_Date = {Last Service Date},
		AffNum,
		Schedule_Desc = {Schedule Desc},
		Age_Band = {Age Band},
		Last_Name = {Last Name},
		Due_To_Date = {Due To Date},
		ErrorCode)) ~> FlatFileDestination
ExcelDestinationErrorReformat derive({} = {}) ~> ExcelDestination0
ExcelDestination0 sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		{} = Provider_Last_Seen)) ~> ExcelDestinationERROROUTPUTFILE
